description: Reload classification for UPROPERTYs that do not update live through /kdf reload or hot pack configuration. Matching: class includes subclasses, property name is case-insensitive. reload: cold = needs a restart (or does not affect existing state), newActors = only affects newly spawned actors, hot = explicit whitelist that overrides other rules. Properties of AActor/UActorComponent class defaults are classified newActors by rule unless the patch sets applyToSpawnedActors: true or an entry here says otherwise. Entries with verified: false are reasonable assumptions that still need an in-game reload check.

entries.reason: Unlocks are granted when a schematic is purchased. Schematics purchased before the change keep the unlocks they granted.
KDataForge resets the cached stack size after every write, so the change applies live.
Item form is read when inventories, conveyors and pipes are set up for an item; existing logistics keep the old form until a restart.
Machines keep their old recipe list until a restart.
